apps.name: Galaxy Gridiron
apps.summary: A read-only fantasy football companion for Sleeper leagues.
description: Galaxy Gridiron is a read-only companion for Sleeper fantasy football leagues. It never changes anything in your leagues and needs no password: you type your own Sleeper username and it shows your teams across six tabs (Team, Matchup, League, Waivers, Trades and Picks). Tap any player for his card, news and live stats; the chat button answers questions about your team.

New in v0.0.10: backup quarterbacks are counted correctly in drop, pickup and trade tips; the player card shows a "Live now" box with points, projection and a stat breakdown during his game; picks are banana yellow so they no longer look like a win; and the Picks leaderboard grid, now called "Picks by week", shows the newest week first. The duplicate weekly chart and the video buttons were removed.

It is an Expo / React Native (TypeScript) Android app, with an iPhone web-app (PWA) export that you add to your Home Screen from Safari. An optional Cloudflare Worker powers the AI chat, so the app itself never holds an AI key.

platformNotes.web: iPhone web app (PWA), added to the Home Screen from Safari.

apps.name: Swipe Clean
apps.summary: Swipe through your photos to decide what to keep and what to delete.
description: Swipe Clean helps you tidy a photo library one swipe at a time: swipe left to add a photo to your Delete pile, right to keep it, with undo, combos and a daily streak. The app never deletes anything by itself and never pre-selects photos; you remove them yourself through Android's own delete dialog (or in Google Photos on the web).

New in v0.0.6: Lil, the mascot, sits centred in a rounded header on every page; the swipe screen header shows Photos done and Minutes today; Settings has an Appearance choice of Dark (default), Light or Match my phone; and rapid taps on Lil no longer get stuck. v0.0.5 added a new app icon and Lil's happy reactions and idle poses, with Show Lil and Calm mode switches that respect your phone's Remove animations setting.

The Android app is built with Expo / React Native and a small Kotlin module that talks to MediaStore. The Web version is a browser demo for Google Photos using the Picker API with a read-only scope; it runs in demo mode with generated placeholder photos until you add your own Google OAuth client ID.

platformNotes.web: Browser demo (Google Photos Picker, read-only); demo mode without your own OAuth client ID.

apps.name: Kanban Board
apps.summary: A shared, offline-tolerant Kanban board for two people, with a TV mode.
description: Kanban Board is a shared board for two people. A tiny Node.js server with no dependencies holds the one real copy of the board, and every open screen (phones, computers and a wall TV) updates within about a second when someone adds, edits, moves or deletes a card. Cards have priorities, owners, tags, due dates and checklists.

New in v0.02: if the server can't be reached, the board keeps working on the device you used last and queues your changes until it is back, with a Live / Reconnecting / Offline status dot. Each device asks once "Who are you?" (no passwords; it only sets the default owner and the last-changed-by note). TV mode (?tv=1) shows big text and a clock with no buttons. Export and Import still work, the server keeps rolling backups, the most recent change wins, and deleted cards stay deleted.
It runs in any browser and needs Node.js 18 or newer on the server. The repo includes install, kiosk and watchdog scripts for a Raspberry Pi.

platformNotes.web: Runs in any browser; self-hosted with a small Node.js server (Raspberry Pi scripts included).

apps.name: Cat Health Dashboard
apps.summary: A small web app for logging your cats' health, with a weight chart per cat.
description: Cat Health Dashboard is a small single-page web app for logging cat health: weight, food, water, litter box, behavior, symptoms, meds given, vet visits and upcoming appointments, with a weight chart for each cat. Each entry shows who logged it.

It installs as a web app on phones, caches data offline in the browser, and syncs between phones through a here.now Site Data collection that you set up with your own config. Cats are added in the app; no data lives in the repo.
Built for cats (it has a litter box log and cat wording), but the fields are simple, so a fork can adapt it to other animals.

platformNotes.web: Installable web app (PWA) for phones; needs your own sync config to share data between phones.
